Subject: Hosted API evaluation - quickstart, endpoints & rate limits

Hi Jane / Mike,

Great to meet you both on the demo earlier - thanks for walking through your prompt examples. Quick recap and next steps so we have everything on one thread: 

What we discussed:
- You want to evaluate hosted API first to validate output quality and integration speed.
- Key evaluation criteria: latency (95p < 200ms for short queries), per-token cost, and VPC/dedicated options if we hit PII/regulatory requirements.

Immediate next steps (from Redwood):
1) Quickstart guide & test API key - attached.
2) Example endpoints and recommended request patterns for chat/streaming and embeddings.
3) Rate limits / burst guidance - see sample CSV attached.

From your side:
- Confirm which team will run the integration (backend or data infra).
- Share any compliance constraints (e.g., SSNs, retention needs) that might push you to Dedicated or Private.

I'll provision a short-lived test key (48h) and a small hosted quota so you can hit the endpoints without needing a billing commit. If you expect higher concurrency we can adjust the quota.

Attachments: redwood-hosted-quickstart.pdf (quickstart steps + example curl/snippets), sample-rate-limits.csv

Thanks - available tomorrow 11-1 PT if you want a follow-up pairing session with Dev.

- Marissa

2) What are realistic rate limits we should expect on the short-lived test key vs GA hosted customers? We need to architect retries and batching accordingly.

Date: 2026-06-02T09:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API evaluation - quickstart, endpoints & rate limits

Hi Jane / Mike - quick answers below, and copying Dev & Solutions so we can smooth any integration issues.

1) Endpoint & streaming:
- Hosted REST endpoint: https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate (chat and completions)
- Embeddings endpoint: https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings
- Streaming: supported on hosted via chunked HTTP and SDK streaming helpers. See section 3 in the quickstart PDF for example node/python snippets.

2) Rate limits:
- Test key (the one I'll provision): 60 requests/minute with a soft burst of 120 for 30s. Token concurrency limited to ~2000 tokens/sec total across the key.
- GA hosted: default starter tier is 600 rps per account (varies by plan). We publish limits per-account and can increase for trials on request.
- Best practices: client-side batching of short prompts, exponential backoff (retry after 500-1000ms), and prefer streaming for long responses to reduce perceived latency.

3) Migration path (Hosted -> Dedicated/Private):
- If you decide you need Dedicated: we can provision reserved capacity (1-4 weeks lead time depending on pool availability) and migrate model pinning/data isolation.
- Private (VPC/on-prem): usually a multi-week project involving network setup and KMS integration (4-8 weeks typical). We can run a compliance review during evaluation to flag blockers early.

Next steps: I'll issue the test key and add Mike to our sandbox org. Marcus - can you look at the concurrency numbers and flag anything that needs engineering signoff for a larger trial? Dev, if Mike runs into any SDK/integration issues I'll set up a pairing session.

Thanks -
Marissa
